title.full: Where to get subsidised SOC referrals

summary.text: Singapore Citizens can go to polyclinics, or CHAS clinics if they have a CHAS, MG, or PG card. Permanent Residents can go to polyclinics.

details.heading: Singapore Citizens
details.body: You can get subsidised referrals at polyclinics. If you have a CHAS, Merdeka Generation, or Pioneer Generation card, you can also get them at CHAS clinics.

details.heading: Permanent Residents
details.body: You can get subsidised referrals at polyclinics.

details.heading: Healthier SG enrolment
details.body: You do not need to enrol in Healthier SG to get subsidised referrals.

example_phrasings: Where can I access subsidised referrals to public specialist outpatient clinics (SOCs)?
Where can I get a subsidised specialist referral?
Can I get a subsidised SOC referral at a polyclinic?

sources.page_title: Where can I access subsidised referrals to public specialist outpatient clinics (SOCs)?

quotes.text: Eligible individuals can access subsidised referrals to public specialist outpatient clinics (SOCs) regardless of their Healthier SG enrolment status, as follows:

Singapore Citizens: You can get subsidised referrals at polyclinics. If you hold a CHAS, Merdeka Generation (MG), or Pioneer Generation (PG) card, you can also get subsidised referrals at CHAS clinics.
Permanent Residents: You can get subsidised referrals at polyclinics.
Enrolment in Healthier SG is not required for subsidised referrals.
